Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX): A completely revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. Driver Assistance Systems: The GLC receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, even stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough
Active Speed Limit Assist automatically adapts the vehicle's speed to identified speed limits in conjunction with the embedded navigation
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident

For example, "If the interior temperature is below 53 degrees Fahrenheit, switch on the seat heating and set the ambient lighting to warm orange." The driver can also assign a name for self-created routines, such as "Warm me up." Under this personally chosen name, the routine then appears on the screen under the menu item "My routines." It is also activated once so the vehicle can start it automatically. This routine category can be recognized by the blue tab in the menu bar. Routines can be created and edited in the vehicle, on the central display.
Transparent Hood (with Exclusive and Pinnacle Trims) : In the Off-road menu, the central display is able to show a virtual view under the front of the vehicle, including the front wheels and steering position. The view is composed of the images from the Surround View 360-degree camera. There are two views: under the vehicle and looking ahead. At speeds up to 5 mph the "transparent hood," i.e. the view under the vehicle, is shown. From 5 to 12 mph the system shows the view ahead. The camera image is switched off at higher speeds.
Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC (standard) makes it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces or garages automatically.
Driver Assistance Systems (optional) : The GLC receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection.
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead.
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation , the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
with Extended Restart in Stop-and-Go Traffic , the vehicle can restart automatically up to 30 seconds after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
and Evasive Steering Assist can support the driver to avoid a road user detected by the system in a dangerous situation.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead or when turning off across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
PRE-SAFE® with PRE-SAFE® Sound (standard) activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
GUARD 360 with Picture Taking Function Capability (optional) : In addition to the features included with the standard Parking Damage Detection, Guard 360 visualizes the surroundings of the parked vehicle, for example if a collision has been detected. All the cameras of the 360° camera system are triggered. The resulting images are time-stamped. These images can be viewed in the central display as well as in the Mercedes me App and can then be used for further analysis purposes.
